item.title: Oleshky residents return to Ukraine
item.description: Residents evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky have reached Ukrainian-held territory following a rare local truce. They described years of isolation, food shortages and regular shelling, with some saying they were forced to eat grass and dogs to survive. Seized by Russian forces in the early days of the 2022 invasion, the city remains cut off by the Dnipro River on one side and Russian troops on the other. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Ming royal descendant turned Buddhist monk painted 12 leaves of birds and flowers, sold for Rs 75 cr
item.description: Bada Shanren, originally named Zhu Da, was born into the Ming royal lineage in 1626. Following the Ming dynasty's collapse in 1644, he sought solace in a Buddhist monastery for many years. Later, he embraced secular life as a renowned painter, crafting works that emphasize bold simplicity. His masterpiece, 'Flowers and Birds,' comprised twelve ink-on-paper leaves and recently fetched HK$61.9 million at Christie's Hong Kong auction. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
